description:
Title: LAN Party

You are planning a LAN party for 10 friends, so the first thing you have to do is to send invitations to these 10 friends.
Next, you have to find out which games they want to play.
As soon as you have received a list of games, you can appoint a date when the LAN party is going to happen.
If 8 or more people agree on this date, you are good to continue.
Else, you have to appoint another date, until 8 people are free to join you.
While you find a date, you can find out if you have all the games your guests want to play.
If some are missing, download them.
Next, you should find out how much beer your friends will require.
If you do not have enough, buy what's missing.
After that, you can enjoy the LAN party.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Planner" name="You" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Start LAN party planning">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Invitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Invitations_Games</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindGamePreferences" name="Find out which games guests want to play">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Invitations_Games</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Games_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationSplit" name="Prepare date and games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Games_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_Date</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_GameCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date for the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_Date</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Date_NotEnough</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Date_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateAgreement" name="Do 8 or more friends agree on the date?" default="Flow_Date_NotEnough">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Date_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Date_Enough</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Date_NotEnough</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Find out whether all requested games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_GameCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GameCheck_Missing</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMissing" name="Are any requested games missing?" default="Flow_Games_Available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GameCheck_Missing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Games_Missing</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Games_Available</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Games_Missing</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Download_GameMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Continue after game availability check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Games_Available</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Download_GameMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GameMerge_PreparationJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_PreparationJoin" name="Date and games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Date_Enough</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GameMerge_PreparationJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Preparation_BeerAmount</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineBeerAmount" name="Find out how much beer friends require">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Preparation_BeerAmount</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerAmount_Check</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerEnough" name="Is there enough beer available?" default="Flow_Beer_Enough">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerAmount_Check</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Beer_NotEnough</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Beer_Enough</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy the missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Beer_NotEnough</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Continue after beer check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Beer_Enough</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Enjoy_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Enjoy_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Invitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_Games" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_FindGamePreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Games_Split" sourceRef="Task_FindGamePreferences" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Date" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_GameCheck" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationSplit" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Date_Check" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Gateway_DateAgreement"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Date_Enough" name="8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAgreement" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">8 or more friends agree to the date</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Date_NotEnough" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAgreement" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameCheck_Missing" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Games_Missing" name="Some games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMissing" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">some requested games are missing</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Games_Available" name="No games are missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMissing" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Download_GameMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GameMerge_PreparationJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Preparation_BeerAmount" sourceRef="Gateway_PreparationJoin" targetRef="Task_DetermineBeerAmount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerAmount_Check" sourceRef="Task_DetermineBeerAmount" targetRef="Gateway_BeerEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Beer_NotEnough" name="Not enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">available beer is less than the required amount</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Beer_Enough" name="Enough beer" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyBeer_BeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMerge_Enjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Enjoy_End" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyParty" targetRef="EndEvent_PartyEnjoyed"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
